text:
emma: observability alert: ap-northeast1c showing sustained fragmentation + higher tail latency for NVLink-backed jobs since 07:12 UTC. Scheduler scattered v100 jobs across AZs.
sahil: yep noticed perf regressions in the TensoBench traces, NVLink peer-attach failures spiked. bandwidth drops ~40%.
rohan: what's causing the scatter? we have zoneAffinity enabled. Could be AZ quota failing so ASG picks other AZs and the scheduler later spreads to balance.
infra-bot: ASG quota events: ap-northeast1c quota exhausted for g4dn-type; recent scale attempts routed to ap-northeast1a/b.
claire: that matches cloud console 1: quota hit on GPU GPUS_PER_ZONE, request id Q-1192. We have pending quota request but not approved yet.
emma: NVLink teams say cross-AZ packing kills multi-gpu jobs that expect NVLink locality -> leads to preemption and reschedule. We saw dozens of job restarts.
sahil: logs show scheduler decided to binpack by available CPU not by gpu-topology. Example: pod annotated with topology.kubernetes.io/zone: ap-northeast1c but node selected in ap-northeast1b because nodeSelectorMatching failed due to rack-reserve taint.
rohan: maybe the rack-reserve taint is too strict; it's causing warm nodes to be ineligible so scheduler grabs other AZs and fragments. Could relax the taint for a short window.
claire: quick mitigations: 1) temporarily lift strict rack-reserve for warm nodes in ap-northeast1c 2) mark warmpool nodes as prefer-local via label `gpu.locality=prefer` 3) add scheduler weight to prefer same-AZ NVLink affinity.
ops-bot: suggested command: `kubectl label nodes -l pool=warm gpu.locality=prefer --overwrite`
emma: also bumping warmpool min size for ap-northeast1c by +3 to keep capacity while quota request is pending. Opening INFRA ticket.
infra-bot: quota request Q-1192 status: pending -> ticket INFRA-9001 opened to escalate to cloud support.
sahil: long-term: scheduler plugin should consider `gpu.topologyGroup` when scoring nodes for multi-gpu pods. Add a prefilter to prefer contiguous NVLink groups. We'll need a SCHED PR.
rohan: agree. Also add admission controller that marks small fractional pods with `pack=packable` so they can be steered to fractional-pool nodes rather than polluting NVLink racks.
claire: can someone own the immediate taint relaxation and label push? I'm on infra calls.
emma: I'll run the label command and increase warmpool via ASG console; doing it now.
ops-bot: action: `kubectl taint nodes -l pool=warm gpu-frag=true:NoSchedule-` (removes taint)
rohan: after labels + pool bump, observing restored locality for multi-gpu jobs, NVLink attach errors dropping. Need to follow up with SCHED-7890 for plugin and INFRA-9001 for quota.
infra-bot: ASG event: ap-northeast1c desired=12 actual=12 after warmpool bump at 07:24 UTC.
claire: putting a watch on cross-AZ network egress costs — temporarily moving jobs back to single AZ will increase egress but reduces restarts; tradeoff logged in INFRA-9001.
sahil: created SCHED-7890 (nvlink-aware-scorer) and INFRA-9001 (quota escalation + warmpool sizing).
emma: thumbs up. we'll keep this thread for notes. closing once NVLink tail stabilizes. :thumbsup:
